Understanding prayer times in Doha

Doha uses the Qatar convention and Asia/Qatar time. In the engine, this convention uses a Fajr angle and an Isha interval after Maghrib, so choosing a different angle-based Isha method can produce different results. Coordinates represent central Doha. Consult your mosque timetable for iqamah times or when a local prayer time differs.

Sunrise is not an obligatory prayer. The mosque sets iqamah, which may follow adhan. The main app lets you change calculation method, Asr convention and location settings.
